        "source": "site-b",
    }
    value.update(changes)
    return value

    events = [
        event(
            "E2",
            follow_up_of="E1",
            onset="2024-01-09T23:30:00-05:00",
            seriousness="hospitalization",
            source="site-a",
            uncertain=True,
        ),
        event("E3", follow_up_of="E2", onset="2024-01-11T00:00:00Z", seriousness="fatal"),
        event("E1"),

    original = deepcopy(events)
    deadline = datetime(2024, 1, 17, 4, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    assert triage_events(events, now=deadline) == [

def test_deep_copy_behaviour_never_mutates_the_caller_or_the_executor_input():
    original = request(
        history=[{"action": "imported", "attachments": {"deep": ["a", "b"]}}],
        status="approved",
        approval_expires_on="2025-02-01",
    )
    snapshot = deepcopy(original)
    seen = []

    def executor(approved_request):
        seen.append(deepcopy(approved_request))
        approved_request["metadata"]["quality_score"] = 0.1
        approved_request["privacy_plan"]["fields"].append("leaked")
        approved_request["history"].append({"action": "tamper"})
        approved_request["status"] = "executed"
        return {"receipt": {"nested": ["value"]}, "echo": approved_request["id"]}

    executed = apply_reuse_action(original, "execute", "alice", NOW, executor)

    assert original == snapshot
    assert original["status"] == "approved"
    assert original["metadata"]["quality_score"] == 0.95
    assert original["history"] == snapshot["history"]
    assert "execution_result" not in original

    # The executor saw an isolated, still-approved deep copy.
    assert len(seen) == 1
    assert seen[0]["status"] == "approved"
    assert seen[0]["metadata"]["quality_score"] == 0.95
    assert seen[0]["history"] == snapshot["history"]
    assert seen[0] is not original

    assert executed["status"] == "executed"
    assert executed["execution_result"] == {
        "receipt": {"nested": ["value"]},
        "echo": "reuse-001",
    }
    # The stored result is decoupled from what the executor handed back.
    assert executed["execution_result"]["receipt"] is not None
    executed["execution_result"]["receipt"]["nested"].append("mutated")
    assert executed["execution_result"]["receipt"]["nested"] == ["value", "mutated"]
    assert seen[0]["history"] == snapshot["history"]

    current = request(

    )

            "alice",
            datetime(2025, 1, 1, 7, 0, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=-5))),
            "2025-01-01T12:00:00Z",
        ),
        (

            "bob",
            datetime(2025, 1, 2, 18, 30, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30))),
            "2025-01-02T13:00:00Z",
        ),
        (

            "alice",
            datetime(2025, 1, 3, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
